description: Single storey rear extension, single storey side infill extension, rear dormer, dormer to rear outrigger, front roof lights and additional window at side elevation for increase to a 6 bedroom HMO - House in Multiple Occupation (Class C4).
decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority is satisfied that, on the balance of probabilities, the property known as 47 Lancaster Road, London, N18 1HP has been in use as an HMO (Use Class C4) and was in place prior to the Article 4 Direction. The use is therefore lawful, and the Local Planning Authority hereby grants a Certificate of Lawful Existing Development.

The proposed two single-storey rear extensions, rear dormers and front roof lights would constitute permitted development under Article 3 and Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A, B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
